answer: Require each identity to lock a 160-unit refundable bond for twelve epochs. Each epoch assigns one random task and demands three attestations from peers with no shared recent contacts; copied wording, reused proofs, or synchronized timing freezes the bond for four epochs. The ledger checks signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and time windows. Each sybil alias locks 160 units and repeats twelve rounds, while horizon-separated activity reveals coordination; mirror hashes catch reused evidence, and vault receipts preserve an auditable history.
